The presence of HBH can also contribute to alpha-thalassemia through aggregated beta-globin chains. analysis: Alpha-thalassemia can originate from impaired heme synthesis due to the deficit of ferrochelatase or the presence of HBH, which contributes through aggregated beta-globin chains. The presence of HbS (sickle cell disease) and methemoglobin are not directly linked to alpha-thalassemia. Therefore, the most likely correct option is the deficit of ferrochelatase.
